honest_claim: A disorder-aware candidate-generation and interface-PAE ranking system for antibody candidates against intrinsically disordered protein targets. It generates CDR candidates and ranks them by a deployment-grade interface-PAE signal. It does not claim to produce validated binders.

component_claims.claim: Generates CDR candidates via BFN/ProteinMPNN with optional per-residue disorder conditioning against IDP targets.
component_claims.evidence: run_idp_antibody_design pipeline; run_bfn_design with epitope_disorder_profile/disorder_guided; C1 H2 experiment (disorder-guided design wiring verified).

component_claims.claim: Ranks candidates by normalized candidate-to-antigen interface PAE, the only deployment-grade confidence signal (pLDDT/ipTM abstained).
component_claims.evidence: publication/candidate_interface_pae_deployment_v1.json: 3 seeds pass all 6 gates after variance-matching calibration; median scaffold Spearman 0.70-0.87.

component_claims.claim: Documents why AF2 whole-complex ipTM and single-sequence AF2 cannot validate short antibody-peptide interfaces.
component_claims.evidence: publication/af2_scoring_boundary_final_decision_v1.json: native binder ipTM 0.22 single-sequence vs 0.75 with MSA; native vs scrambled peptide indistinguishable via ipTM (0.753 vs 0.755).

explicit_non_claims: Does not claim to produce antibodies that bind IDP targets
Does not claim binding, affinity, specificity, or efficacy
Does not claim to outperform any existing binder or design method
No wet-lab validation (SPR/BLI) has been performed
positioning_rationale: The evidence supports candidate generation and relative ranking, not binding. The claim is therefore scoped to what is demonstrable: generation + ranking, with binding deferred to wet-lab validation.
claim_boundary: This document defines the honest, evidence-supported positioning of the system. Any binding claim requires wet-lab validation and is explicitly outside the current evidence.
